events.title: Dyeversion demo is live
events.summary: I'm excited to announce that the Dyeversion demo is now live on Steam!Dyeversion is a roguelite incremental tower defense where you build your defense by routing colored resources to your towers. Different color combinations create new tower types, while every connection becomes a strategic decision as each source has a limited output shared between all connected towers.The demo features:4-level campaignResource routing and tower combo mechanicsPermanent meta progression with a large skill treeI
